job.title: Software Developer PHP (m/w/d) - E-Commerce & Spryker in Hamburg, Hamburg Zentrale

tailoring.headline: Senior Software Developer | E-Commerce & Integration Specialist | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and agile Scrum teams. Proven record of designing PIM/ERP integrations, optimizing database performance and translating business requirements into robust solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Software Developer PHP (m/w/d) - E-Commerce & Spryker
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Detlev Louis’ focus on innovative cross-channel e-commerce and its collaborative culture. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and integrated complex e-commerce back-ends that align perfectly with your Spryker-based vision.

bullets.label: **Integration Expertise**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, delivering reliable product-catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: **CI/CD & Cloud Delivery**
bullets.text: At Shell I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and leveraged Docker and Kubernetes for containerised releases, ensuring fast, repeatable deployments.

bullets.label: **Agile & Techno-Functional Leadership**
bullets.text: I worked in Scrum teams, wrote user stories, functional specs and led code reviews, bridging business and IT to deliver e-commerce solutions on time.

bullets.label: **Design & Architecture**
bullets.text: My work on API migrations and micro-service design follows solid design patterns and clean-code principles, aligning with architecture-review processes.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Detlev Louis is Europe’s leading motorcycle apparel and tech retailer, operating a fast-growing network of stores and online shops. Your commitment to innovation, continuous learning and a strong Duz-culture resonates with my passion for building high-quality e-commerce platforms. I want to help shape the Spryker-based shop, bring my integration and architecture experience, and grow within a company that values both technology and community.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Detlev Louis to apply my e-commerce integration expertise, drive innovative features on the Spryker platform, and grow in a collaborative, learning-focused environment.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce integration experience. I’m eager to bring my expertise to Detlev Louis’ Spryker team. Could we discuss the Software Developer PHP role? Thanks!
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Software Developer PHP (m/w/d) – E-Commerce & Spryker
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Software Developer PHP – E-Commerce & Spryker position at Detlev Louis. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong integration skills, and a proven record in CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
